newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-TOURNAMENT AS IMPORTANT TO ORGANISERS AS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOURNAMENT AS IMPORTANT TO ORGANISERS AS TEAMS.

text.p: Michel Platini, former France captain who jointly heads the 1998 World Cup organising committee (CFO), made an informal tour on Monday of Lyon's Gerland stadium, venue of Tuesday's opening match of the Tournoi de France.
The four-team tournament, involving France, Brazil, Italy and England, is as important to the CFO as a dress-rehearsal of next year's World Cup finals as it is for coaches and players.
"It was important to know where we stood in our preparations," Platini said in Paris before leaving for Lyon to watch France play Brazil in the opening match.
"Hence our wish, especially at the Lyon venue, to test the whole organisation in a big way: logistics, security, the press centre, the accreditations."
